m1.typescript: m1 the policy allows invoking one model in one region and nothing else

e1.typescript: e1 no action is a wildcard and every action is an invoke action

e2.typescript: e2 every resource arn names one documented region and one model

e3.typescript: e3 every statement allows and the policy uses the current version

e4.typescript: e4 the vertex role is a custom role that can only predict

e5.typescript: e5 the vertex endpoint keeps the data where residency says and serves the model

e6.typescript: e6 model ids use each platforms own form

e7.typescript: e7 the quota request stays under the self service ceiling

wrong-wildcard-action.defect: adds a wildcard action beside the invoke action

wrong-non-invoke-action.defect: adds an action that is not an invoke action

wrong-resource-star.defect: adds a resource that matches every resource

wrong-region-wildcard.defect: adds a model ARN whose region is a wildcard

wrong-undocumented-region.defect: adds a model ARN with a region Bedrock does not list

wrong-predefined-role.defect: binds a broad predefined role instead of a custom role

wrong-extra-permission.defect: adds a deploy permission to the role

wrong-global-for-eu.defect: sends EU-resident traffic to the global endpoint

wrong-regional-new-model.defect: picks a specific region for a model that only the global and multi-region endpoints serve

wrong-bare-model-id.defect: adds a model ARN without the Bedrock provider prefix

wrong-vertex-prefixed-model.defect: gives the Vertex model the Bedrock provider prefix

wrong-haiku-undated.defect: names Haiku 4.5 on Vertex without its date

wrong-quota-over.defect: asks for more input tokens per minute than the self-service ceiling
